text:
$BTC I'm still quite reluctant to buy Bitcoin yet because the retail shorts activity in my Futures Analyzer is not signaling bottom. 

During 2023, this signal peaked and there were non stop red signals getting spammed as seen below. 

No such patterns exist today. 

Therefore I would be cautious and still have my capital remain in US hyperscaler ecosystem stocks. 

One of my best picks was $MRVL (+79.6% return) and I gave a buy signal in Premium on Jan-Feb this year.
